Learn more
📷Scan the table sign
Every table at a partner bar has a QR sign. Scanning it proves you’re really there. No download, it opens in your browser.
✅Verify with Instagram
You DM a one-time code from your own account to @overlap.hq. That proves the account is yours. We never ask for your password.
👀Women look first
Women see the men in the room first and choose who gets to see their profile. A woman can also switch on “Let men wave first”. Then men can wave at her, and she decides whether to wave back.
👋Waves and Instagram
When a man waves, his Instagram shows on her card, with a peek at his posts. She decides whether to wave back. If she does, her Instagram shows to him. Nobody sees an Instagram without a wave.
🤝Meet for real
When you match, Overlap suggests something to say to start the conversation. Say hi in person, then both tap “I met them”. They’re saved in Met with profile and Instagram. There’s no chat in the app.
⭐Quests
Little missions that get you talking to new people, like “find someone who’s lived abroad”. Find them, type their first name, and it’s checked. Two quests earn a free drink from the venue.
🔒Privacy
We don’t track your location. The table scan is the only check-in. Venues set how long a session lasts, and you can hide any time. Venues only see headcounts, never who you are.
